# EVTX writer fixtures

- `sample.xml` — Winevt event XML used as input by `tests/golden.rs`.
- `sample.evtx` — golden reference (69 632 bytes) generated by the **baseline pre-refactor writer** (commit `642a60c34`) from `sample.xml` with `record_id = 1`. `tests/golden.rs` asserts the writer output is byte-identical to this file; it is not self-referential.

Regeneration (only when the encoder intentionally changes the byte layout): check out the new reference commit, run `write_evtx_from_xml` on `sample.xml` with `record_id = 1`, and replace `sample.evtx` with the produced file.
